review:
Built around Collectors. They stay for up to 10 spins, gathering every Cash and Jackpot value beneath them, with multipliers from x2 to x10. Random Cash Out symbols pay their totals on the spot.

Free Spins gives 10 spins where Collectors stay, helped by Countdown Boosters and Collect to Infinity. Hold the Jackpot runs on 16 reels with three respins and a 2,500x Grand. Very high volatility, 96.2% RTP, with Chance Level at x2, x5 or x10.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
